jen: tiny nit — the Python snippet still uses old client import. replace with `from redwood import Client` (and update example cred comment).
lex: fixed in commit 9f8a3c. running local build, will ping when Netlify preview is up.

devin: I'll do a quick pass — aim to merge before 09:00 PT tomorrow.
lex: thanks all :rocket:
